reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker or target engagement data reported. Cannot assess whether the radiolabeled antibody reached and bound GD2 on tumor cells. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pharmacodynamic markers or pathway biomarkers reported to confirm antibody-dependent cytotoxicity or radiotherapy-mediated tumor killing occurred. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Single-arm trial with 31/78 participants showing response at 6 months (39.7% response rate). Without a control arm or historical benchmark, this is difficult to interpret definitively, but for CNS/leptomeningeal cancers this appears to be a modest response rate that may not represent meaningful clinical benefit. Primary endpoint of 6-month overall survival was not clearly reported as met. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Single-arm design without control makes interpretation challenging. No clear statement that primary endpoints were met. Safety profile shows manageable toxicity with fever (7.7%), infection (3.8%), and other SAEs but no dose-limiting toxicity pattern.
